claim: On June 18, 2026 Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ added private networking, which lets brokers open outbound connections to private resources in your VPC using Amazon VPC Lattice, AWS RAM and AWS PrivateLink, without exposing them to the public internet.
question: When did Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ add private networking (outbound connections to private resources)?

qualifiers.scope: outbound connections of Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ brokers to private resources in a VPC

note: d028. June 18, 2026 is before 2026-07-15, so examinable (low exam weight).
